lines: 天空一碧如洗，金黄色的稻穗在阵风吹拂下，犹如波涛一般起伏。
地里的农人正在挥汗如雨地忙着收割，然而，别说唱首山歌，大多数人就连喘口气说话的功夫都没有。除了偶尔飞过聒噪一下的鸟儿，只有那沙沙的收割声。
站在官道旁一道田埂上的张寿欣喜地看着这丰收的一幕，手中拿着一把稻穗，笑眯眯地看着围在身边的几个农人。
“前年收成是还不如种麦子，可去年就已经比往年略有富余，今年看这光景，只要紧赶着收完，看这光景，恐怕能比大前年的出息多六成。谁说北方不能种水稻？”
听到周围都是附和，他想到之前发现村中附近水系丰沛，很适合种水稻时，哪怕母亲吴氏犹犹豫豫最终答应尝试并开渠减租，这些佃户依旧不情不愿的场面，不禁唏嘘不已。
人家穿越都是高配高起点，他这个小地主家的少爷却是举步维艰，要不是今年丰收，光是他在村里又是开水渠，又是种水稻，又是试验种棉田，又是扩养柞蚕，又是劝说人家抽时间让孩子们跟着他背诗认字，只怕回头要被村里这些农人背后骂死。
这年头，地主可以夺佃，但佃户也可以抗佃！他们孤儿寡母的，他还折腾了这么一气，最终没捅大篓子，村中景况稳步提升，还真是运气好！
就在这时候，戴着斗笠的他眼角余光瞥见，一旁相隔数步的通衢大道上，一行七八个衣衫鲜亮的骑马护卫，正簇拥着一辆清油车缓缓而行，显出了那么一股不慌不忙的悠闲。
车厢窗帘被一只纤纤素手高高打起，虽说只是侧面一扫，他仍然依稀看见，那是个年轻少女。知道如今这年头不比后世，他只瞥一眼就收回了目光，继续背对着官道与几个农人商议日后如何复种，谁知道转瞬间就听到了车中两个人的对话。
“大小姐，最近府里是什么状况，你也应该清楚。老爷战事不利，大少爷和麾下兵马又失去了音讯，朝中不少对头正磨刀霍霍，二少爷他为了保住这家业，不得不拉拢人。如今他想结亲兵部陆尚书，那也是……”
“保住家业？他从前斗鸡遛狗的时候，何尝想过上进两个字？爹是不是诈败还说不好，大哥也不过是暂且没消息，他就敢打我的主意！”
“我知道大小姐瞧不上陆尚书家里那个娇生惯养的幺儿，可难不成就相信太夫人说的所谓婚约？老爷一向疼大小姐，怎么会把你许配给一个长在乡下身世不明之人？更何况，太夫人拿着婚书，却又不给大小姐和二少爷看正文，真假如何尚未可知。”
“陆家那个猪头文不成武不就，拈花惹草倒是娴熟，每次看见我就露出垂涎三尺的蠢样，我恨不得踹翻了他暴打一顿！还想娶我……呸，癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉！再说，我可没答应祖母要依着她那婚书嫁人，只不过是来看看！”
听了前半截，张寿暗自叹气，心想这样一个出身显贵的大小姐，竟然也会被人逼嫁，真命苦，可听到大小姐那最后彪悍的发言，他不禁觉得，她真的不需要人同情。
不过这两人说话丝毫不顾忌旁人听到，大概是觉得在这乡间，没人懂这些公卿家事。
然而下一刻，他就再也没有同情别人的余裕了。因为他赫然发现，那马蹄声仿佛停了下来，说话两人中的那个男子，竟然在拿他们这些乡下人打比方！
“就算婚书是真的，老爷多年决口不提，也许心中早就后悔了。大小姐从前在府里何等金尊玉贵，难不成今后就要生活在这乡间，管着外头这样一堆乡下泥腿子，然后日日和一群不识字的农妇打交道？”
张寿正愠怒时，那男子更是直接把矛头指向了他。
“大小姐你看这年纪轻轻的农家子，长于乡间目不识丁，诗词歌赋一窍不通，整日来往的也就是农夫山民，贩夫走卒，日后能得一个温饱便心满意足，一辈子走不出田间地头。而他是农家子，他儿子也是农家子，他的孙子还是农家子。长于如此农家子之中，怎能不庸碌？”
就算张寿本来懒得和陌生人相争，此时也再忍不住了。
他头也不回地说：“农家子家无恒产，确实读不起书，所以大多数人只能目不识丁，天天锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土，得个温饱就心满意足。可有些人吃着盘中餐，不知粒粒皆辛苦，还瞧不起农家子时，就没听说过肉食者鄙，未能远谋？”
话音刚落，他就听到一阵清脆的笑声，不禁微微一愣，随即摘下斗笠转过身来。
这一次，他终于看清楚了，马车中靠他这一边坐着一个十五六岁的少女。
她一身彩绣辉煌的大红绉纱衣衫，乌黑油亮的发间，随着那笑声，一支金步摇正颤颤巍巍，金叶做的蝴蝶仿佛正在金花丛中嬉戏，追逐簪尾那颗熠熠生辉的南海明珠。
腕间一对红玉镯，衬得她白皙的肌肤犹如凝脂。
和这一身华服美饰相得益彰的，是她那一张艳光逼人的脸。
四目对视，他就只见那少女突然止住了笑，竟是目不转睛地盯着自己，当下便大大方方地回了一个笑容。而他这一笑之后，对方就非常明显地呆了一呆。
朱莹确实没办法不发呆。她在京城时，上至深宫大内，下至权贵府邸，就连青楼楚馆也曾女扮男装去见识过，街头更是打马飞驰惯了，算得上是阅人无数。她可以保证，她见过的所有适龄少年加在一块，也挑不出一个如眼前这乡间少年这般出众的。
明明只是一身普普通通的青布衣衫，一双黑布鞋履上甚至还沾着泥土，可他却眉目清朗，清俊闲雅，乍一看她便觉得风仪无双！
而且正好顺着朱公权劝他的话，把他给噎了回来！
记得爹从前还常常忆苦思甜，说家里祖上出自田间呢！
她回过神，展颜笑道：“小郎君，刚刚对不住了，是我家这位朱先生出言不慎冒犯了你。要是你再背一首硕鼠硕鼠，无食我黍，他就该找一条地缝钻进去了！”
张寿知道马车中的少女出身豪门贵邸，此时见她对自己说话时竟明摆着帮他，他不用想都知道，也许是因为那番话，但更多的也许是因为自己如今这张脸！
他这三年已经看多了这种景象，习惯成自然，便笑而不语，只是微微点头。
作为赵国公朱泾留在京中协助料理内外的同姓幕僚，今天陪着朱莹下乡到所谓未婚夫家去，朱公权哪曾想自己随便拿个农家子打比方，却被人反过来笑话他不读书，再加上朱莹竟然也胳膊肘向外歪帮着别人，他一时恼羞成怒。
要不是这农家子居然一副好容貌，他也不至于这么倒霉……朱莹素来爱看美人！
粉妆玉琢的小孩子，风度翩翩的美少年，卓尔不凡的俊大叔，风仪宛然的帅老头……当然也包括性格爽利的美女。总之，只要是美人，打一开始就能从任性的她那得到好言善待。
她的口头禅是，俊逸君子，淑女好逑。
至于如果嫁了美男子，将来人老了怎么办，她的回答也很简单——真正的君子，温文尔雅，容貌和品行才能自当一致，哪怕岁月流逝，依旧是俊大叔，帅大爷……如果做不到，那就配不上君子二字！再说，女人尚且知道保养自己，男人如何不能好好善待自己这张脸？
不过他要报这一箭之仇也容易，只要证明这农家子品行不堪，性情差劲。毕竟，大小姐这性情名声在外，有的是登徒子仗着一张脸就生出非分之想，最终被拆穿倒霉的多了去了！
content_en:
The sky was as clear as water, and the golden rice ears undulated like waves under the gusts of wind.
The farmers in the fields are busy harvesting, sweating like rain. However, let alone singing a folk song, most of them don't even have time to take a breath and speak. Except for the occasional noisy birds that fly by, there is only the rustling sound of harvesting.
Standing on a field ridge beside the official road, Zhang Shou happily watched the harvest scene. He held a handful of rice ears in his hand and looked at the farmers surrounding him with a smile.
"The harvest the year before last was not as good as growing wheat, but last year was already slightly more abundant than in previous years. Looking at the situation this year, as long as we finish the harvest quickly, I am afraid we can make 60% more than the year before last. Who said we can't grow rice in the north?"
Hearing the echoes from everyone around him, he couldn't help but feel sad when he thought about how the tenants were still reluctant even though his mother Wu hesitated and finally agreed to try and open canals to reduce rent when he discovered that the water system near the village was rich and suitable for growing rice.
People who travel through time travel are well-matched and have a high starting point, but he, the young master of a small landowner family, is struggling. If it hadn't been for this year's bumper harvest, he would have been scolded to death by the farmers in the village behind his back just because he was opening canals, planting rice, experimenting with cotton fields, expanding tussah breeding, and persuading people to take time to let the children memorize poems and read Chinese characters after him.
These days, landlords can seize tenants, but tenants can also fight against them! They were orphans and widowed, but he still struggled so much, and finally did not make a big mistake, and the situation in the village steadily improved. He was really lucky!
At this moment, from the corner of his eye, wearing a bamboo hat, he caught a glimpse of a group of seven or eight horse-riding guards in bright clothes on the thoroughfare a few steps away, surrounded by a clear oil truck, walking slowly, showing such a leisurely and unhurried look.
The curtains of the carriage were raised high by a delicate hand. Although it was only a side sweep, he could still vaguely see that it was a young girl. Knowing that these days are not as good as those of later generations, he only glanced at them and withdrew his gaze. He continued to discuss with several farmers with his back to the official road on how to replant crops in the future. Unexpectedly, he heard the conversation between two people in the car in an instant.
"Miss, you should also know what is going on in the house recently. The war is going badly for me, the eldest young master and his soldiers have been lost again, and many enemies in the court are sharpening their knives. In order to keep the family business, the second young master has to win over people. Now he wants to marry Lu Shangshu of the Ministry of War, so that's..."
"Keep the family business? When he was fighting cocks and walking dogs, how did he ever think about making progress? It's hard to say whether dad is cheating on me or not, and there's just no news about my eldest brother, so he dares to take advantage of me!"
"I know that the eldest lady despises the pampered youngest son in Lu Shangshu's family. How can I believe the so-called marriage contract that the madam said? I have always loved the eldest lady, how could I betroth you to a person who grew up in the countryside and has an unknown background? What's more, the madam holds the marriage certificate, but does not show the text to the eldest lady and the second young master. It is not known whether it is true or false."
"That pig-headed guy from the Lu family is incompetent in martial arts, but he's really good at flirting with women. Every time he sees me, he looks like he's salivating. I wish I could kick him over and beat him up! He wants to marry me... Bah, the toad wants to eat swan meat! Besides, I didn't promise my grandmother to get married according to her marriage contract, I'm just here to see!"
After listening to the first half of the story, Zhang Shou sighed secretly, thinking that such a young lady from a noble family would be forced to marry, and her life would be miserable. But after hearing the young lady's final and powerful speech, he couldn't help but feel that she really didn't need sympathy.
However, these two people did not worry about others hearing what they said. They probably felt that no one in this country could understand the affairs of the ministers and their families.
However, the next moment, he no longer had the time to sympathize with others. Because he suddenly discovered that the sound of horse hooves seemed to have stopped, and the man among the two talking was actually making a comparison with country people like them!
"Even if the marriage certificate is true, the master has not mentioned it for many years, and maybe he has already regretted it in his heart. The eldest lady used to be so noble in the house, is it possible that from now on she will live in the countryside, take care of a bunch of country dirt-legs outside, and deal with a group of illiterate peasant women every day?"
When Zhang Shouzheng was angry, the man pointed the finger directly at him.
"Miss, look at this young peasant boy. He grew up in the countryside and is illiterate. He knows nothing about poetry and poetry. The people who come and go all day are farmers, mountain people, traffickers and pawns. In the future, he will be satisfied with food and clothing, and will never leave the fields. And he is a farmer's boy, his son is also a farmer's boy, and his grandson is still a farmer's boy. How can he not be mediocre if he grows up in such a farmer's family?"
Even though Zhang Shou was too lazy to fight with strangers, he couldn't bear it anymore.
He said without looking back: "Farmers have no permanent property and cannot afford to study, so most people can only be illiterate. They hoe every day at noon, sweat dripping from the soil, and are satisfied with just food and clothing. But some people are eating on the plate, not knowing that they have worked hard for every grain, and when they look down on the peasants, haven't they heard that meat eaters are despicable and have no foresight?"
As soon as he finished speaking, he heard a burst of crisp laughter. He couldn't help but be slightly startled, then took off his hat and turned around.
This time, he finally saw clearly that there was a fifteen or sixteen year old girl sitting on his side of the carriage.
She was wearing a bright red crepe dress with brilliant embroidery, and her shiny black hair. With the laughter, a golden step was trembling, and butterflies made of gold leaves seemed to be playing among the golden flowers, chasing the shining pearl of the South China Sea at the tail of the hairpin.
A pair of ruby ​​bracelets on her wrists made her fair skin look like gelatin.
What complemented this gorgeous outfit was her dazzling face.
When their eyes met, he saw that the girl suddenly stopped laughing, staring at him intently, and immediately smiled generously back. And after he smiled, the other party was obviously stunned for a moment.
Zhu Ying really couldn't help but be in a daze. When she was in the capital, she went to the palaces, to the mansions of powerful people, and even to the brothels and palaces, where she dressed up as a man and was used to riding horses and galloping on the streets, so she was able to meet countless people. She could guarantee that of all the young men of the right age she had ever seen, she would not be able to pick one as outstanding as the country boy in front of her.
He was obviously just wearing an ordinary blue cloth shirt, and a pair of black cloth shoes were even stained with mud, but he had clear features, handsome and elegant. At first glance, she felt that he had an unparalleled grace!
And just as Zhu Gongquan persuaded him, he choked him back!
I remember that my father often recalled the bitterness and sweetness in the past, saying that our ancestors grew up in the fields!
She came back to her senses, showed her face and said with a smile: "Young man, I just couldn't help but it was my Mr. Zhu who accidentally offended you with his words. If you carry the song "Shuo Shuo Shuo Shu" again, he will find a crack in the ground and crawl in! "
Zhang Shou knew that the girl in the carriage came from a wealthy family, but when he saw her talking to him, she was obviously helping him. He didn't need to think about it, maybe it was because of those words, but more probably because of his face now!
He has seen this kind of scene so much in the past three years that he has become accustomed to it, so he smiled and said nothing, just nodded slightly.
As Zhao Guogong Zhu Jing's aide with the same surname stayed in Beijing to assist with domestic and foreign affairs, he accompanied Zhu Ying to the countryside to the so-called fiancé's house today. Zhu Gongquan never thought of using a farmer's son as an analogy, but he was laughed at because he didn't study. In addition, Zhu Ying actually tilted her elbows outward to help others, which made him angry for a moment.
If this peasant boy hadn't turned out to be so good-looking, he wouldn't have been so unlucky... Zhu Ying has always loved looking at beauties!
A child with pink makeup, a handsome boy with a graceful demeanor, an extraordinary handsome uncle, a handsome old man with elegant demeanor... Of course, there are also beauties with a cheerful personality. In short, as long as you are beautiful, you will be able to get kind words and good treatment from the willful her from the beginning.
Her catchphrase is, a handsome gentleman, a good lady.
As for what she will do when she gets older if she marries a handsome man, her answer is simple - a true gentleman must be gentle and elegant, and his appearance and conduct should be consistent. Even if the years pass, he will still be a handsome uncle and a handsome uncle... If he cannot do this, then he is not worthy of the word gentleman! Besides, if a woman knows how to take care of herself, why can’t a man take good care of his face?
However, it would be easy for him to avenge this attack. All he had to do was prove that the farmer's character was bad and his temperament was bad. After all, the eldest lady has a reputation for her temperament, and there are many people who are deceitful and have unreasonable thoughts based on their appearance, and many of them are unlucky in the end when they are exposed!
